svg.title: Match engine system design
svg.text: One dependency-free engine in the middle. The visualizer, the Node tools and the tests all call it, and real league data sets its targets.
React context that survives route changes: team sheets · seed · live session · last report · history · settings
same stats for real and simulated
step · runUntil · runToEnd · substitute · setTactics · setFormation
save / Match.load · snapshot · on · result · explain
src/data · committed · targets and real squads
fail if the engine drifts from real football or breaks a law
QUICK_TESTS=1 skips the 17 statistical tests and runs the other 71 in about 17 s
on pull requests and pushes to main
skips .md-only changes · a new push cancels the old run
